answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through a bounded-length random-walk kernel, so influence decays when paths cross weakly linked regions. A sybil cluster is a sparse external cut: its low conductance limits escape probability and, by min-cut transitivity bounds, caps the aggregate voting weight it can import. Thus, a terrace of honest attestations outweighs a sybil vine, even when identities multiply.
